verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs explicitly list the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as a supported target on the PyTorch and JAX install pages, and state that ROCm 7.2.1 supports Radeon 9000 Series (RDNA 4) GPUs on Linux and Windows. That support sits alongside a documented HIP library stack (hipBLAS, hipFFT, hipSOLVER, rocPRIM, etc.) and profiling/debug tooling for shipping compute workloads. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of compute workloads running on this card, the general ROCm compatibility-matrix entry naming the part is not shown directly, and Windows support is documented only for PyTorch.
